protocol.initialization: Reference pose (joint positions clipped to soft limits), reference velocities; reference position targets, zero velocity/feedforward targets and warmstart before forward
protocol.randomization: None; model nominal friction/inertia/COM, zero encoder bias, no pushes
protocol.assistance: Command disabled, all events removed, gain and applied wrench verified zero
protocol.sensing: Ideal simulator state, actor corruption disabled
protocol.coverage: Training-set tracking; errors include samples up to and including failure
protocol.metrics: Post-control state against newly advanced reference; mean over joints/bodies then time
protocol.target_scope: Initial nominal tracking targets, reported separately from numerical stability
